nodes.label: Durable local storage
nodes.rationale: Retains queued notifications locally so delivery state survives interruptions.

nodes.label: Local webhook testing
nodes.rationale: The repository includes a Node.js receiver for local webhook testing.

nodes.label: Payload template variables
nodes.rationale: Supported placeholders include deviceId, packageName, appName, title, text, postedAt, and notificationKey.

nodes.label: Queue system
nodes.rationale: Provides durable local storage for notification delivery.

nodes.label: Retry system
nodes.rationale: Retries webhook delivery using network constraints and backoff.

nodes.label: Webhook configuration
nodes.rationale: Exposes URL, HTTP method, authentication, headers, query parameters, and payload template settings.

nodes.label: Webhook forwarding
nodes.rationale: Forwards captured notifications to a configurable webhook API.
